plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SMH as it is flagged and to reduce semiconductor concentration.
Reduce SPY to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Increase QQQI to 25% to favor income and broad index exposure.
Trim CRWD to 10% to cap single name exposure at 20%.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation and low drawdown. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, but still carries market risk, especially from remaining tech exposure.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SMH to 10% as it is flagged and to reduce semiconductor concentration.
Reduce SPY to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Buy NFLX at 4% as a strong scanner setup to diversify.
Trim CRWD to 10% to reduce concentration.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a small cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth by reducing leverage and concentration. It blends broad index exposure with quality tech, but market volatility can still impact returns.

plan: Increase SOXL to 6% and SPAL to 6% to lean into leveraged ETFs.
Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Buy NFLX at 6% as a high-scoring scanner setup.
Increase CRWD to 18% to press what is working.
Trim SMH to 10% as it is flagged.
This plan uses leverage and concentrates in high-scoring setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretch growth by using leverage and concentration. This approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid losses.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SMH to 5% to reduce high-beta single name exposure.
Reduce SPY to 20% to meet the concentration mandate and favor income.
Increase QQQI to 30% to rotate into income-focused ETFs.
Trim QQQ to 10% to reduce growth exposure.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield and steady distributions. While prioritizing low drawdown, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff, meaning it is not a savings account.
